summary: The diff adds substantial frontend scaffolding (routing, layout, theme, auth hook usage) and implements core post rendering, likes, comments UI, image validation, and a following-only feed toggle. However, several BuildRequest requirements are either not evidenced in the diff (e.g., search page behavior, pagination, profile counts/relationship state, auto profile creation) or only partially implemented. There are also signs of unrequested/possibly non-compliant additions (use of a blob-storage mixin and a branded footer link).

missing_requirements.requirement: On first sign-in, a minimal profile is created automatically (or via a one-time onboarding screen).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a manual Edit Profile page calling createProfile, but no evidence of automatic profile creation on login/first sign-in or an onboarding flow.

missing_requirements.requirement: Users can view another user's profile page showing avatar, display name, bio, and counts (posts, followers, following).
missing_requirements.reason: Routes include /u/$principal, but the diff does not include ProfilePage implementation or any evidence of follower/following/post counts rendering.

missing_requirements.requirement: Store posts in the Motoko backend and display them in the frontend with required fields (postId, author principal, caption, createdAt/timestamp, image reference).
missing_requirements.reason: Backend post type includes required fields, and frontend displays posts, but backend file is truncated and does not show read APIs (e.g., getFeed/getPostsByUser) implementation details; frontend calls these methods without evidence they exist in backend in the provided diff excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Feed supports pagination or incremental loading without duplicating posts.
missing_requirements.reason: FeedPage uses a single query returning PostView[] and renders all posts; no pagination/infinite loading mechanism is shown (no cursor/page params, no 'Load more', no infinite query).

missing_requirements.requirement: On another user’s profile, a follow/unfollow button reflects current relationship state; users can follow/unfollow; counts update after follow/unfollow.
missing_requirements.reason: FollowButton only renders a 'Follow' action and never switches to 'Unfollow' or reflects relationship state. There is no evidence of relationship query/state, nor follower/following counts UI updates. Backend follow/unfollow logic is truncated.

missing_requirements.requirement: Discovery UI: user search (by display name) with loading and empty-result states; selecting navigates to profile.
missing_requirements.reason: A Search route exists and a SearchResultRow component exists, but the SearchPage implementation and its loading/empty states and actual search query wiring are not shown in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generated static images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated (logo, default avatar, empty-state illustration).
missing_requirements.reason: UI references the expected asset paths, but the diff summary does not show the actual image files being added under frontend/public/assets/generated (they may be among omitted files, but there is no evidence in the visible diff).

hallucinated_features.description: Use of a blob-storage mixin/imports in the backend (ExternalBlob, MixinStorage) which may imply additional storage service beyond a single Motoko actor.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constrains the backend to remain a single Motoko actor and not rely on external object storage/CDNs; the diff introduces `blob-storage/Storage` and `blob-storage/Mixin` without being requested and may violate constraints depending on what blob-storage resolves to.

hallucinated_features.description: Branded footer content and external link to caffeine.ai.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any requirement; adds external branding/link unrelated to specified features.
